from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanySurplusReserve(BaseModel):
    """One company's surplus reserve data from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported")
    surplus_reserve_amount: float | None = Field(description="The surplus reserve amount in yuan, extracted from the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A brief verbatim excerpt containing the surplus reserve value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanySurplusReserve]
